about_the_game:
You control a ninja slashing through enemies, but your movement is limited. You have randomized movement pieces, which move your ninja from one tile to another and slay every enemy you move over. This requires some tactical thinking to choose fitting movement pieces to hit your enemies. This has slight similarities to how chess pieces can move.

There is also a timer in which you need to slay your enemies. This should be easy at the beginning, but at later stages you need to move fast to not run out of time.

Different types of enemies and bosses will appear. You earn money to buy equipment and use it to modify your movement pieces.

It is a roguelike, so if you die, you will lose everything and be thrown back to the start.
